cohort: 3043 Chinese women with live singleton births through assisted reproductive technology (ART)
finding: Women with pre-pregnancy overweight or obesity who conceived through ART were more likely to experience cesarean section, gestational diabetes mellitus, gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, and have infants with macrosomia.
mod_finding: Women with pre-pregnancy overweight or obesity who conceived through ART were more likely to have a cesarean section.
